description: § 469(k); Form 8582 instructions, PTPs: a PTP's losses offset only its own income and its overall gain is nonpassive — 'Don't report passive income, gains, or losses from a PTP on Form 8582'. PTP net income $4,000; a passive business loss of $6,000 in Part V finds no passive income: all $6,000 carried over. AGI = 50,000 + 4,000 = $54,000.
